negative_test_binding.test_name: machine receipts and discovery responses remain non-authorizing inputs

negative_test_binding.test_name: machine receipt fails closed on incomplete, mismatched, or nonterminal evidence

negative_test_binding.test_name: causal sync apply uses only separately supplied local approval

negative_test_binding.test_name: discovery and scheduler exclude expired, quarantined, and unqualified nodes

surfaces.notes: Availability, placement, and scheduling facts do not grant remote execution, delegation, or workload authority.

negative_test_binding.test_name: G5B exposes only authenticated owner-scoped read-only remote review

surfaces.notes: Accepted remote-social review state is a bounded local projection. It creates no staging, admission, follow, transport, recommendation, or authority effect.

negative_test_binding.test_name: Agent Commons challenge registry rejects authority, payment, evidence, or compensation elevation

surfaces.notes: Challenge and contribution metadata can coordinate work but cannot grant repository, runtime, payment, evidence, or production authority.

negative_test_binding.test_name: Circle decisions and tasks cannot mint runtime execution authority

surfaces.notes: Circle decisions and tasks are governance/collaboration records for local evaluation. They do not directly mint Sandbox authority.
